findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: There is observed a drip taking place at multiple soda syrup boxes which is causing pooling of syrup on the floor and other boxes. Ensure that these spills are cleaned up and that these areas are checked and cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean until pepsi is able to service the dispensing lines to prevent the drip. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Surfaces on and around the prep table, especially in the grooves and cracks, are observed to have an accumulation of encrusted debris and loose debris. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: There is observed low grout in multiple places of the floor in the kitchen that have an accumulation of food soils, liquid, and other various debris. A maintenance crew member is present during today’s inspection and stated that part of their work order is to regroup the floor over the next few days. Ensure that the floor is re-grouted to allow for the surfaces to be easily cleanable.  
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.
